textual_extract: It is when defending them is difficult. We see that test wherever civilians are dehumanized; wherever minorities face hatred; wherever migrants and refugees are denied dignity; and wherever women and girls are excluded from education, employment and public life. It was clear from the debate that gender equality cannot remain peripheral to our agenda.
portrayal_justification: Marked as Vulnerable / Protection-Oriented because women and girls named among groups excluded from education, employment and public life, in closing remarks on the session's gender-equality theme.
